text: emma_cs: Heads-up — Skybridge renewal next week. Procurement asks for split billing (US + APAC), a 6-month term, and onboarding to start when PO is uploaded. Need product ok.nina_onboard: We can run pre-kickoff workshop and reserve 2 enablement seats; full SSO/seat activation requires signed contract or a PO with explicit acceptance.phil_sales: Customer offered 6mo +3.5% and keeping 2 enablement credits; they expect to upload PO today.
